name: quark-mcp
description: Manage Quark Net Disk files through MCP, including search, transfer, sharing, and file operations.
long_description: A local MCP server for Quark Net Disk. It runs over stdio and requires a Quark Net Disk cookie. Supporting hosts collect the cookie as a sensitive setting during installation and pass it to the server as QUARK_COOKIE. Do not put a real cookie in this package or in public metadata.

cookie.title: Quark Net Disk Cookie
cookie.description: Cookie copied from a logged-in Quark Net Disk session. Keep it private; it grants access to your account.

tools.name: list_files

tools.description: Delete one or more files or folders.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a file to a local path.

tools.name: get_download_status
tools.description: Check the status of a download.

tools.name: regex_rename

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search recursively for files or folders.

tools.name: get_share_file_list
tools.description: List files at the root of a shared link.
